mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the federal funds rate exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the unemployment rate is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, leading to increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where housing starts increase and unemployment rate decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates an increase in supply, leading to decreased prices and increased demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where industrial production exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP indicate an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where the federal funds rate decreases and GDP increases.

mechanism_narrative: A high payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where payroll employment exceeds 155000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, leading to increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where retail sales increase and unemployment rate decreases.
